title: Advanced Server Actions
description: Revalidate cached data, handle errors gracefully, and optimistically update the UI.

slides.title: Revalidating the Cache 🔄
Revalidation Example (app/actions.js)
slides.content: After creating a product, revalidate the product list.

quizData.question: What does `revalidatePath('/blog')` do?

options.text: Purges the cache for the /blog route, causing it to regenerate on the next request

quizData.explanation: `revalidatePath` marks the route for regeneration. The next visitor gets the fresh data.

slides.title: Error Handling & useFormState 🧨
useFormState Example (components/NewPost.js)
slides.content: Combines server action, validation, and UI feedback.

quizData.question: Which hook allows a client component to receive the return value of a Server Action?
quizData.explanation: `useFormState` from `react-dom` pairs with a Server Action and provides the action's return value as state.

slides.title: Optimistic Updates ⚡
Best Practice ✨
slides.content: Combine `useFormState` for error handling, `useOptimistic` for snappy UI, and `revalidatePath` for cache refresh. This trio gives you a robust and delightful form experience.
